<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def plus(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==9:
            bb=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            if r0>46 and c0>21 and c1 if False else True:
                pass
    # simpler: use known tile centers
    res={}
    for name,(r,c) in {'T':(50,30),'L':(55,25),'R':(55,35),'B':(60,30)}.items():
        for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
            bb=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            if abs(r0-r)<=1 and abs(c0-c)<=1:
                res[name]=n['color']
    return res
print('before:', plus(current_frame))
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':30}])
print('after:', plus(history[-1].frame), 'changed:', r.get('board_changed'))
# check spinner size too
def size(fr):
    tot=0
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']>=2:
            bb=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in bb); c0=min(p[1] for p in bb)
            if r0>=17 and c0>16: tot+=n['pixels']
    return tot
print('size before/after:', size(current_frame), size(history[-1].frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
